name: LayerZero V2
description: LayerZero is a technology that enables applications to move data across blockchains, uniquely supporting censorship-resistant messages and permissionless development through immutable smart contracts.

methodology.Fees: Native token fees paid by users for cross-chain messaging, summed from ExecutorFeePaid and DVNFeePaid events on SendUln302 (V2 default) and SendUln301 (V1-compat through V2 endpoints) across supported chains.
methodology.Revenue: ZRO buybacks funded by Stargate ecosystem allocation routed to LayerZero Foundation. LayerZero takes a 0% protocol take rate on messaging fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: LayerZero takes a 0% protocol take rate on messaging fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ZRO buybacks distributed to ZRO holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Approximately 100% of messaging fees flow to DVNs and Executors that secure and deliver cross-chain messages.

hallmarks: Record $4B daily bridged volume, driven by a single $3.6B WPAY transfer (Polygon to Arc)

Fees.DVN_FEES: Native token fees paid to required and optional DVNs that verify cross-chain messages.
Fees.EXECUTOR_FEES: Native token fees paid to Executors that deliver and execute messages on the destination chain.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: ZRO bought back using Stargate ecosystem revenue.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: ZRO bought back and distributed to holders.
